subject.title: fix(signal): preserve newlines in debounced messages

question: Should this Signal delivery fix require a redacted real receive-path capture before merge, or is the focused regression test plus exact-head hosted gate an acceptable proof exception?
rationale: The code change is narrow and the test contract is clear, but the contributor could not exercise a linked Signal account; the protected maintainer label makes the acceptable evidence threshold a human decision.

options.title: Require real Signal receive proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted receive transcript, bridge log, or terminal capture showing one debounced batch reaches the agent with actual line breaks after rebasing.

options.title: Approve a documented proof exception
options.body: Accept the focused before/after regression coverage and hosted gate as sufficient for this low-scope text-joining correction, while recording that no linked Signal account was available.
